# Credits (Core Developer)

Third-party assets used by the Core Developer (`Assets/Models/Custom`, `Assets/Textures/Models`, `Assets/Prefabs/Props`,
`Assets/Prefabs/Models`). Every third-party mesh, texture or sound needs a row here **before** it is committed. Use CC0
sources only unless the team agrees otherwise.

**Status after step C4: no third-party asset has been added yet.** Everything in the repository so far is generated by the
Editor tools (primitive placeholders, sign textures drawn by `DecalRenderer`) or modelled by me, and needs no credit. The
tables below are the slots the CC0 packs will fill, with the sources I checked.

## Weapon viewmodels

`Weapon_Smg_Visual`, `Weapon_Sniper_Visual` and `Weapon_Knife_Visual` are primitive placeholders built from the
prototype's own part sizes (`WeaponDefinitions`). To use a free low-poly mesh instead, import it as
`Assets/Models/Custom/SM_Weapon_<Name>.fbx` and run **Blackout > Art > Build Weapon Prefabs**; only the `Model` child is
replaced. The gloved hands and sleeves are part of the viewmodel, so a pack that has only the gun needs the hands added
(keep the placeholder's `Glove*` and `Sleeve*` parts, or model them in Blender).

| Prefab | Used now | Source asset | URL | Licence | Author |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Weapon_Smg_Visual | placeholder (primitives) | none yet | n/a | n/a | n/a |
| Weapon_Sniper_Visual | placeholder (primitives) | none yet | n/a | n/a | n/a |
| Weapon_Knife_Visual | placeholder (primitives) | none yet | n/a | n/a | n/a |

Candidate packs (listed as CC0 1.0 on their download pages when I checked; **I have not downloaded or inspected them**, so
confirm the licence text in the zip and the actual model list before using one):

| Pack | URL | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kenney, Blaster Kit | https://kenney-assets.itch.io/blaster-kit (official page: https://www.kenney.nl/assets/blaster-kit) | CC0 1.0. FBX, OBJ, GLB. Sci-fi blasters, so it suits the SMG and the rifle only if the team accepts that look. |
| Quaternius, Ultimate Gun Pack (also listed as "50+ LowPoly Guns") | https://quaternius.itch.io/50-lowpoly-guns | CC0. FBX, OBJ, Blend. Realistic low-poly guns: the closest match to the prototype's SMG and rifle. A user reports FBX textures can import black; assign the Unity materials after import. |
| A knife | not chosen | Quaternius also publishes low-poly weapon packs (for example the medieval weapons pack on the same account); check that a modern combat knife is in it. |

When a pack is used, replace the row above with the file name, the asset's name inside the pack, its page URL, "CC0 1.0"
and the author shown on the page. Keep the pack's licence file next to the model if the pack ships one.

## Signs and decals

The 19 sign and floor-marking textures (`T_Sign_*_BaseColor.png`) are drawn by `DecalRenderer` from the sizes, colours and
text of the prototype's sign list, with a 5 x 7 dot font written for this project (`BitmapFont`). No third-party image or
font is used, so there is nothing to credit.

## Textures

None. Every material in `Assets/Materials/Models` uses the prototype's flat colours. If a CC0 texture is added later, list it
here with the surface it is used on, its source asset, URL, licence and author, as in `docs/credits/world-builder.md`.
